description: Design fixture for the future Runtime Default Injection of the Knowledge Contract Snippet into Claude Code / Codex / hermes_pro prompts. This is a spec-only fixture; no runtime, no handoff write, no IPC, no gateway, no ingest, no Claude Code / Codex / Hermes subprocess, no system prompt runtime modification.

l4_l5_boundary.L4_dry_run: HCC handoff payload can carry snippet at payload.context.contracts.knowledge_reuse. No real injection. (achieved by Slice 007K / 007L / 007M.)
l4_l5_boundary.L5_runtime_default_injection: Snippet is attached to the agent prompt or task dispatch prompt at runtime, without user manual paste. This is the layer 008A designs, but does NOT implement.
l4_l5_boundary.slice_008A_scope: Design only. 008A does NOT implement L5. 008A does NOT modify any runtime, default system prompt, or handoff writer.

targets.name: claude_code
targets.rationale: primary executor for P3 code/project tasks; contract snippet is the canonical way to prevent Obsidian / MEMORY / .wolf behavior

targets.name: codex
targets.rationale: OpenAI Codex compatibility; same 8-rule contract; target-adjusted but core preserved

targets.name: hermes_pro
targets.rationale: reserved for future Hermes self-call opt-in; today not default-injected to avoid recursion

targets.name: hermes_self_call
targets.rationale: reserved: no default attach to avoid recursion. Explicit override only.

surfaces.name: A_handoff_payload_context_contracts_knowledge_reuse
surfaces.description: Inject snippet at payload.context.contracts.knowledge_reuse during HCC handoff payload build. Read-only contract data; payload remains in memory or tmpDir until 008+.
surfaces.scope: narrow (only the handoff payload carries it)
surfaces.rollback: remove from builder; fall back to L4 handoff-only

surfaces.name: B_task_prompt_preamble
surfaces.description: Inject snippet as a preamble section of the task prompt assembled for the agent at dispatch time. Read-only contract data; the rest of the task prompt is unchanged.
surfaces.scope: medium (every dispatched task prompt gets the preamble, not every system prompt)
surfaces.rollback: remove the preamble step from dispatch prompt assembly

surfaces.name: C_default_system_prompt_fragment
surfaces.description: Modify the agent's default system prompt to embed the snippet as a permanent fragment. Affects all tasks the agent handles, not only those dispatched by Hermes.
surfaces.scope: global (every task the agent handles, including those outside Hermes)
surfaces.rollback: revert the system prompt change; restore the prior fragment
surfaces.blast_radius: high (pollutes all tasks, including non-Hermes tasks)

recommended_surface.name: B_task_prompt_preamble
phase_1_rationale: Surface A is already covered by L4 (Slice 007K / 007L / 007M); no further L5 work needed for A
Surface B is narrower than C: only Hermes-dispatched tasks receive the preamble
Surface C modifies global default system prompt and pollutes all tasks (including non-Hermes); high blast radius
Surface B is reversible per slice: if the preamble misbehaves, we remove the preamble step without touching the system prompt
recommended_surface.phase_2_rationale: After Surface B proves stable in production for one or more slices, we may revisit Surface C as a global optimization, but only with a separate ADR and explicit user approval

trigger_conditions: User says 'save' / 'persist' / 'ingest' / 'archive' / '存到' / '沉淀' / '写入' (zh or en)
User says 'research' / 'compare' / 'analyze' / '调研' / '对比' / '选型' (zh or en)
Handoff context has ingest_draft or flush_pending: true
Handoff context has both local_known + newly_found (canonical 4-section answer shape required)
no_trigger_conditions: Ordinary code-only task (refactor / bug fix / test addition) without knowledge save intent
Purely local file operation (e.g. 'list files in src')
Hermes self-call (reserved; no default attach even with all triggers firing)
safety_gates: snippet source must come from buildKnowledgeAgentContractSnippet (Slice 007I) or buildKnowledgeHandoffContractSnippet (Slice 007J) — no inline literal
assertKnowledgeContractNoRuntime (Slice 007I) must pass before snippet is attached
assertKnowledgeHandoffContractNoRuntime (Slice 007J) must pass before snippet is attached
snippet envelope must carry runtime_flush_allowed=false and dry_run_only=true (latter during the L5 phase 1 dry-run only)
snippet must not contain knowledgeIngest( / knowledgeSearch( / runPlaybook( / triggerCronJob( / sendMessage( / fetch( as call expressions
snippet must not contain Obsidian / MEMORY / .wolf path recommendation
snippet must not contain deceptive-phrase (已保存 / 写入成功 / saved successfully / will be written after confirm)
target_agent must not be 'hermes' (self-call reserved) unless caller provides an explicit override flag, and even then must be guarded by shouldAttachKnowledgeContract + caller_explicit_attach
injection must be visible in a dry-run artifact (e.g. handoff payload's context.contracts.knowledge_reuse envelope) before any real dispatch
snippet length must be ≤ max_chars (default 2048); overflow truncated with truncated=true and audit trail

failure_modes.name: snippet missing when expected
failure_modes.cause: trigger fires but no snippet is produced (helper throws, or build path skipped)
failure_modes.detection: triggers_to_inject_observed but no envelope in dry-run artifact
failure_modes.response: fail the dispatch (do not silently send prompt without contract); emit dry-run artifact for review

failure_modes.name: snippet attached to ordinary code task
failure_modes.cause: trigger matching is too permissive; ordinary code-only task gets snippet
failure_modes.detection: request_text does not contain save / research keywords AND task_kind ∉ research family AND handoff context has no ingest_draft / flush_pending / local+newly
failure_modes.response: fall back to L4 (no preamble); do not inject

failure_modes.name: snippet attached to hermes self-call
failure_modes.cause: target_agent override slips through reserved guard
failure_modes.detection: target_agent === 'hermes' AND no explicit override flag
failure_modes.response: throw; do not inject; emit dry-run artifact showing the rejection

failure_modes.name: runtime token leakage in snippet
failure_modes.cause: caller mutates the snippet before injection, or future slice introduces a new forbidden token
failure_modes.response: throw; abort dispatch; emit dry-run artifact for review

failure_modes.name: overlong snippet
failure_modes.response: truncate + truncated=true + audit trail; do not silently drop the truncated portion

failure_modes.name: user-visible overpromise wording
failure_modes.cause: snippet drifts to include '已保存' / '写入成功' / 'saved successfully' / 'will be written after confirm'
failure_modes.response: throw; abort dispatch; emit dry-run artifact showing the offending copy

failure_modes.name: source fidelity or bucket semantics omitted
failure_modes.cause: snippet variant loses the 8 core rules
failure_modes.response: throw; abort dispatch; emit dry-run artifact

failure_modes.name: dispatch prompt changed without artifact
failure_modes.cause: snippet injected but dry-run artifact not updated
failure_modes.response: throw; abort dispatch; refuse to inject without a matching dry-run artifact

feature_flag.name: KNOWLEDGE_CONTRACT_INJECTION_ENABLED
feature_flag.default: false (L4 handoff-only is the production default)
feature_flag.scope: process-wide; can be toggled per task or per workspace

rollback_strategy.remove_from_dispatch_prompt: Surface B rollback: remove the preamble step from the dispatch prompt assembly. No code path touches the agent's default system prompt.
rollback_strategy.fall_back_to_L4: After Surface B rollback, handoff payload's context.contracts.knowledge_reuse remains the only place where the snippet lives. L4 behavior is fully preserved.
rollback_strategy.preserve_no_write: Rollback must not write to ~/.hermes/handoff/packs or ~/.hermes/audit. mtime guard at /Users/midoudou/.hermes/handoff/packs and /Users/midoudou/.hermes/audit must remain unchanged.
rollback_strategy.keep_live_flush_disabled: After rollback, runtime_flush_allowed must still be false. knowledgeIngest must still not be called. live search must still not be called.

test_plan: unit: shouldAttachKnowledgeContract 5 trigger true + 4 not-attach false (Slice 007I)
integration: dry-run handoff payload carries envelope (Slice 007L)
L5 dry-run: payload.context.contracts.knowledge_reuse is the input to the dispatch prompt preamble (NOT yet a runtime change; this slice is design only)
L5 runtime: deferred to a future slice with explicit user approval and a separate ADR

GO: 008A design only (L5 design documented; injection surface B recommended; safety gates + failure modes + rollback defined)
NOT_GO: L5 runtime default injection implementation (留 future slice + 显式批)
Surface C (global default system prompt) as first step (高 blast radius)
